provenance.notes: Round-to-nearest-even conversions. FP8/FP4/FNUZ/bf16 via ml_dtypes from float32-representable inputs (ml_dtypes rounds float64 inputs through float32, so float64-only inputs are excluded). fp16/fp32 via NumPy direct float64 conversion. Overflow behaviour is ml_dtypes' non-saturating behaviour (E4M3/FNUZ -> NaN, E5M2 -> Inf) except FP4 E2M1 which saturates.
